footer.aboutText: <name>Chiz.Pink</name> is a daily companion app for Neverness to Everness (NTE). Plan your Esper and arc ascensions, track your pulls and pity on every banner, check off your dailies and weeklies, and keep count of your materials. Everything is saved in your browser locally without an account.
footer.disclaimer: <about>CHIZ.PINK</about> is an unofficial project and is not affiliated with <studio>HOTTA STUDIO™</studio>

iosSafari.title: Install on iPhone/iPad
iosSafari.step1: Tap the Share icon in Safari's toolbar.
iosSafari.step2: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
iosSafari.step3: Tap 'Add' in the top right corner.

iosOther.title: Install on iPhone/iPad
iosOther.step1: Tap the Share or menu icon in your browser's toolbar.

macosSafari.title: Install on Mac
macosSafari.step1: Click the Share icon in Safari's toolbar.

firefox.title: Install on Firefox
firefox.step2: Tap 'Install' or 'Add to Home screen', if available.
firefox.step3: If it's missing, use Chrome, Edge, or Safari to install Chiz.Pink instead.

samsung.title: Install on Samsung Internet
samsung.step1: Tap the menu icon in the toolbar.

other.title: Install Chiz.Pink
other.step2: Look for 'Add to Home Screen' or 'Install App'.
other.step3: Follow the prompts to finish installing.
